title: A joint bitcoin transaction with equal-value outputs
summary: The funds take part in 1 to 3 joint transactions that pay out equal values to a new wallet. The new wallet then passes them through 1 to 4 extra wallets.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 60 cases in 100.

parties.label: the wallet that holds the funds
a joint transaction with equal-value outputs
a new wallet that receives the outputs
the last wallet after the extra hops

steps.say: The funds go into 1 to 3 joint transactions that are about 1 hour apart.

basis.note: The report describes joint transactions with equal-value outputs. The count of 1 to 3 transactions, the first wait and the gap between them are assumed. Europol gives about 1 hour only for a single round.

steps.say: Each joint transaction pays out the same value to a new wallet.

basis.note: The Europol assessment says that a single mixing round can take 1 hour, which sets the wait.

steps.say: The new wallet passes the funds through a few extra wallets.

basis.note: The report describes extra hops after the joint transaction. The count of 1 to 4 and the waits are assumed.
